answer: In an agent economy, each identity must lock 100 tokens for 90 days to receive one vote on marketplace rules. A pigment trader called zephyr can create more accounts, but each needs its own deposit; moving tokens across a bridge cannot reuse funds already locked in escrow. Buying 1,000 votes therefore ties up 100,000 tokens for three months, imposing capital costs and exposure to token price changes on the attacker.
